scope: Extend the P6-G generated POLYFACE transaction profile to multiple face records and signed vertex indices, which encode invisible-edge state.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored records generated during each test run
source.profile: Five coordinate vertices and two four-slot face records. The faces include both positive and negative indices, with zero terminating inactive slots.

implementation.method: For each version/encoding, inject allocation failure at every allocation reached by the successful whole dxfRW::write; require destination and caller state preservation, retry using the same codec, compare exact output bytes, and inspect fresh typed readback for both face records and signed indices.

limitations: Generated DXF transaction and readback evidence only; producer interoperability and native CAD edge display are not qualified.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: POLYFACE multi-face records and signed indices roundtrip with allocation rollback and same-codec retry for AC1014, AC1021, AC1024, and AC1032 in ASCII and Binary.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue the public-writer inventory for other compound-record variants and variable-size OBJECTS builders; retain source-profile and semantic gates.
